summary: Acer Aspire 5 14 (Model: A514-52GQ) is experiencing thermal throttling due to high system temperatures. The laptop features a 12th Gen Intel Core i5-1135G7 processor, 8GB DDR4 RAM, and 128GB NVMe SSD.
detected_fault: High system temperatures causing thermal throttling, likely due to inadequate cooling or dust buildup.
suggested_solution: Regularly update drivers and BIOS, use a high-quality power adapter, consider upgrading RAM to 16GB or more, and maintain optimal temperatures using a cooling pad or external fan.
